messages:
samir: quick heads-up - we're planning to unpin SDK v3.2 in eu-west tonight 23:00PT but found a quant/kernel selector regression that causes wrong kernel for qv2-retro models. proposing to sticky-pin runtime for that model-group until a microkernel fix ships.
hana: agree. let's keep qv2-retro routed to runtime:2.14.1+kvpatch and stagger SDK unpin for everything else.
ops-bot: suggested ops steps: add holdlist, create runtime pin, reserve canaries. opsctl snippets: `opsctl holdlist add qv2-retro --reason "kernel-selector-regression" --until 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z` 
ops-bot: `opsctl pin create --target runtime:2.14.1+kvpatch --scope model-group:qv2-retro --ttl 36h`
sre: reserving 2 warmup pods in eu-west and 1 in eu-central. healthcheck target 200rps. I'll attach the warmup/runbook link in thread.
deploy-bot: scheduled job: sdk-unpin-eu-west @2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. Rollout slices: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 30m. Canary: eu-west (2 pods). Escape hatch: `deploy-bot rollback --job sdk-unpin-eu-west --reason telemetry`
hana: rollback triggers (short): 1) 5xx +0.5% vs baseline 2) p95 latency +25% for qv2-retro after routing 3) token-error-rate or OOM spike 4) eval drift on core-10 >4%. If any fire, abort and re-pin SDK/runtime as needed.
samir: add automated eval run every 5m against core prompts and page #incidents on drift. Hana, can you take docs/customer comms if we need rollback?
hana: yes, will draft a short CS note and internal release note. include expected impact: p95 bump ~10-15% for pinned qv2-retro and potential GPU utilization increase.
sre: warming canaries now, ETA 8m. will post runbook and metric queries. recommend 20m cooldown between slices.
ops-bot: holdlist + runtime pin created: id=hl-12277 pin=rp-12277 expires=2026-03-25T04:00:00Z
deploy-bot: started rollout: slice=10%. canary pod-1 healthy, pod-2 warming. metrics dashboard linked.
samir: monitoring looks OK for first slice. keep eyes on p95, TER and eval drift.
sre: pod-2 healthy -> advancing to 40% per plan. ready to abort on alert.
hana: reminder checklist pre-unpin: holdlist present, runtime pin active, canaries healthy, alerts configured, release notes drafted, on-call paged. all owners ack?
samir: ack. hana: ack. sre: ack.
deploy-bot: rollout reached 100% at 2026-03-24T00:06:40Z. no rollback triggered.
hana: follow-ups: 1) keep pinned runtime until patch merged + 24h stabilization 2) run compatibility smoke across other model groups in 48h 3) postmortem note linking PR for kernel selector fix. I'll file the docs PR.
